name: lidocaine + mineral oil + petrolatum + phenylephrine
purpose: Purpose Lidocaine 5% w/w....................................Local anesthetic Mineral Oil 17% w/w................................Protectant Phenylephrine HCl 0.25% w/w.................Vasoconstrictor White Petrolatum 39% w/w.....................Protectant
uses: Uses helps relieve the pain, itching and burning associated with hemorrhoids temporarily reduces the swelling associated with irritated hemorrhoidal tissue and other anorectal disorders temporarily provides a coating for relief of anorectal discomforts temporarily protects irritated areas and inflamed perianal skin
otcwarn: Ask a doctor before use if you have heart disease high blood pressure thyroid disease diabetes difficulty in urination due to enlargement of the prostate gland Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking a prescription drug for high blood pressure or depression Stop use and ask a doctor if bleeding occurs condition worsens or does not improve within 7 days allergic reaction occurs to ingredients in this product symptom being treated does not subside or if redness, irritation, swelling, pain or other symptoms develop or increase
